transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
Mostly it’s my sleep. I just don’t sleep right anymore. I lie there for a long time, and when I do fall asleep, I wake up from bad dreams or even little noises. Then I can’t seem to settle back down.
Do you feel tired or have trouble functioning during the day because of your sleep problems?

Yes, I do feel worn out in the day. It’s mostly because I’m not sleeping right. I’ll lie there a long time, and then if I do sleep, I wake up from bad dreams or just little noises. After that, I can’t really settle back down, so the next day I’m tired and not doing much good.
How often do the bad dreams happen? Are they almost every night, or just occasionally?
Not every single night, but it’s more than just once in a while. I wake up from them pretty often, and even when it’s not a bad dream, little noises can wake me up and then I can’t get settled again.
How many nights a week would you say you have trouble sleeping like this?

I’d say maybe four or five nights a week. It’s not every night, but most nights I’m either lying there a long time or I wake up from a bad dream or some little noise, and then I can’t settle back down.
Does this trouble with sleeping happen even when you’re not feeling particularly stressed or anxious, or does it seem to be related to how you’re feeling emotionally at the time?

It can happen even when I don’t feel all that worked up. I mean, being upset probably makes it worse, but mostly I’m here because I just don’t sleep right anymore. I’ll lie there a long time, and then I wake up from bad dreams or just little noises, and after that I can’t seem to settle back down.

When you have trouble sleeping, is it mainly that you have a hard time falling asleep at the beginning of the night, staying asleep through the night, or waking up too early and not being able to go back to sleep?

It’s both, mostly. I have a hard time falling asleep at first, I’ll just lie there a long while. Then if I do get to sleep, I wake up from a bad dream or even just a little noise, and after that I can’t seem to settle back down.
Do you ever wake up feeling unrefreshed, like your sleep wasn’t restful, even if you managed to sleep for a while?

Yeah, I do. Even if I get a few hours, it doesn’t feel like good sleep. I’m up and down, or I wake from a bad dream or some little noise, and then I can’t really get settled again. So I get up feeling like I didn’t really rest.
Even when you do manage to sleep for a few hours, does it feel like you’re not really getting proper rest, or that your sleep isn’t refreshing?

Yes, that’s right. Even if I sleep a few hours, it doesn’t feel like real rest. I’m either lying there a long time before I fall asleep, or I wake up from a bad dream or some little noise, and then I just can’t settle back down.
Would you say that waking up from bad dreams or noises happens at least three times a week, or less often than that?
Yeah, I’d say it’s at least three times a week. It happens pretty often now—I’ll wake from a bad dream or just some little noise, and then I can’t get settled back down.
When you wake up during the night from a bad dream or a noise, does it take you a long time to fall back asleep, or do you usually drift off again fairly quickly?
It usually takes me a long time. I don’t just roll over and go back to sleep. I’ll lie there awake, kind of listening, and I just can’t seem to settle back down.
When you're lying awake at night or trying to fall back asleep, do you find yourself feeling anxious, worried, or down about things?
Yeah… mostly I’m just laying there not sleeping right. I’ll be trying to get back to sleep, but I’m awake after a bad dream or some little noise, and I can’t settle down again. It wears on me.
Have you noticed any problems during the day like trouble concentrating, irritability, or difficulty getting things done because of your sleep issues?

Yeah, some days I’m just tired and not getting things done like I should. Mostly it’s because I don’t sleep right anymore. I lie there a long time, then I wake up from bad dreams or little noises, and after that I can’t seem to settle back down.
Is there ever a night where you don’t wake up from a bad dream or a noise and actually feel like you slept well, or does this seem to happen almost every night?

It’s pretty much most nights now. I don’t have many nights where I just sleep through and wake up feeling rested. I’ll be lying there a long time, or I wake up from a bad dream or some little noise, and then I can’t get settled again.
Do the bad dreams you wake up from feel especially vivid, intense, or disturbing, and do they cause you a lot of distress during the day?

Yeah, they can be pretty upsetting when they wake me up. I don’t know if I’d call them vivid, but they’re bad enough that I’m awake after, and then I just can’t settle back down. That’s mostly why I’m here — I’m just not sleeping right anymore.
Has your sleep problem caused you a lot of distress or made it hard for you to do things you need to do during the day, like work or taking care of things at home?

Yeah, it has. I can still get through the basic stuff, you know, getting dressed, eating, that kind of thing. But I don’t go to the senior center like I used to, and I’ve been leaving more things around the house for my wife to handle. I used to do more of those chores.

And I don’t see my bridge friends much anymore either. So… my days have gotten a lot smaller, I guess.

Outside of what you've already mentioned, have you noticed any other areas of your life where this lack of sleep has been causing problems, like with friends, family, or your ability to enjoy activities you used to like?

Yeah… I guess with things I used to enjoy. I still water the garden, and I still mess around with old radios a little, but it just doesn’t feel the same. The good feeling I used to get from doing those things… it doesn’t really come like it used to.
Have you noticed that you take less pleasure or interest in things you used to enjoy, like your garden or working on old radios?

Yeah… I have. I still do those things — I water the garden, and I’ll sit and work on an old radio some — but it doesn’t give me that same good feeling it used to. It’s like I’m doing it, but I’m not getting much out of it.
Have you been feeling down or having little pleasure in life most days, even outside of your sleep troubles?

Yeah… not so much feeling down all the time, but the pleasure part, yes. I still water the garden, and I still tinker with old radios some, but that good feeling I used to get from it just doesn’t come like it did.
